pages.title: Purpose
pages.text: The Coal Generator burns furnace fuels such as coal and charcoal to produce power. It generates 40 SE per tick by default; server settings may change this. At the normal tick rate, 20 ticks equal one second.$(br2)Build a power supply before starting precision manufacturing.

pages.title: Connection
pages.text: Place the generator and connect consumers with power cables. Right-click to check its fuel slot and stored energy. Hoppers and logistics can supply fuel.$(br2)Add generators for sustained demand, or use a buffer to cover short bursts.

pages.title: Cleanroom placement
pages.text: Generators pollute cleanrooms. Keep them outside and carry power through the wall with a Cable Coated Cleanroom Block to preserve the seal.$(br2)Provide enough power for both the conditioner and the machines inside.
